claims.text: Adjuvant meds (clonidine, acetaminophen, loperamide, ondansetron) for OUD w.draw w/o offering maintenance Tx = substandard care
claims.quote: Stabilizing someone with OUD in opioid withdrawal with adjuvant medications ( clonidine , acetaminophen , loperamide , ondansetron ) without offering maintenance treatment for OUD is considered substandard care.
